reviews.title: Quality case, budget friendly. Not for beginners.
reviews.comment: Neat case to build in but not for beginners. Cable management is very much needed for the friction clips to hold on the rear panel. With a full size ATX MB it does require creativity to get the cables ran clean. While the case itself is spacious the PSU location is very tight for an ATX PSU, it would have been great if the PSU cage was 2 inches longer, I had to install the PSU, then fish the male ends into the PSU and made the cable access hole impossible to put more than just the 24pin MB power through. Fans that came pre-installed are quiet and move a decent amount of air. I definitely recommend getting an ARGB/Fan hub to make life easier. This case for the price is a good deal, it is very sturdy, has a lot of room and I do like that every grille has a magnetic dust filter. All 3 glass panels are friction clipped on and hold strong. When I unboxed the case I noticed it was packaged very well with dense foam holding the case and glass studily in place and dense cardboard corner protectors as you would get when you order a high end case. Overall I am pleased with Mesetex for the quality at a very nice price.
reviews.author: Joshua

reviews.title: Good but be cautious on fitting gpu.
reviews.comment: Looked good, with good build quality but had to return it because installation of pny 5090 was not possible on my Asus rog strix cross hair hero x870 motherboard. There is good space for gpu length, but the back panel is designed in such a way that gpu L plate will get stuck at an angle and will not fit even on the pcie slot.
reviews.author: Rahul

reviews.title: Great case. love the unconventional MB placement.
reviews.comment: I love this case I have bought 2 so far. I like it because of it unconventional layout of the MB. Great cable management. Easy access of just about everything.
reviews.author: Jeremiah Gasparin

reviews.title: Does not fit ATX motherboards
reviews.comment: Quality is very good, however it does not fit a full size ATX motherboard. An ATX motherboard is about 1/2” too big for this case.
